##

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(moments)

# Load the two CSV files
rounds <- read_csv("data/analysis/rounds.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
round_states <- read_csv("data/analysis/round_states.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Join keys: your files use round_num, not round_id
join_keys <- c("match_id", "round_num")

# Keep only columns from rounds that aren't already in round_states
round_info <- rounds %>%
  select(
    all_of(join_keys),
    is_overtime,
    is_pistol_round,
    ct_won_previous_round,
    ct_buy_type,
    t_buy_type,
    ct_equipment_freeze_end,
    t_equipment_freeze_end,
    first_death_side,
    freeze_end_tick,
    plant_tick,
    end_tick,
    round_duration_s,
    winner_team,
    reason_name
  )

# Attach round-level information to every snapshot
round_states_enriched <- round_states %>%
  left_join(round_info, by = join_keys)

# Verify the result
cat("Original snapshot rows:", nrow(round_states), "\n")
cat("Merged snapshot rows:", nrow(round_states_enriched), "\n")
cat("Merged columns:", ncol(round_states_enriched), "\n")

# Save the merged dataset
write_csv(round_states_enriched, "data/analysis/round_states_enriched.csv")

write_parquet(
  round_states_enriched,
  "data/analysis/round_states_enriched.parquet"
)
```

## unique round filter (GLOBAL)

```{r}
unique_round_filter <- round_states %>%
  distinct(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r}
filtered_rounds_global <- round_states %>%
  semi_join(
    unique_round_filter,
    by = c("match_id", "round_num")
  )
```

## unique round filter (BY MAP)

```{r}
unique_round_filter_maps <- round_states %>%
  distinct(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r}
filtered_rounds_map <- round_states %>%
  semi_join(
    unique_round_filter,
    by = c("match_id", "round_num", "map")
  )
```

## Round-end summaries

For each round, use the latest recorded snapshot at or before `end_tick`. Because snapshots are sampled periodically, this is an approximation of the round-end state; an exact `tick == end_tick` row may not exist.

## check

```{r}
filtered_rounds_global %>%
  filter(tick <= end_tick) %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num) %>%
  slice_max(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    mean_t_health_global = mean(t_hp, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ct_health_global = mean(ct_hp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_t_health_global = sd(t_hp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ct_health_global = sd(ct_hp, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r}
filtered_rounds_map %>%
  filter(tick <= end_tick) %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  slice_max(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(map) %>%
  summarise(
    ## Means
    mean_t_alive_map = mean(t_alive, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_t_health_map = mean(t_hp, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ct_alive_map = mean(ct_alive, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ct_health_map = mean(ct_hp, na.rm = TRUE),
    ## SD
    sd_t_alive_map = sd(t_alive, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_t_health_map = sd(t_hp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ct_alive_map = sd(ct_alive, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ct_health_map = sd(ct_hp, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r}
round_end_health <- filtered_rounds_map %>%
  filter(tick <= end_tick) %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  slice_max(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  collect()

round_end_health_long <- round_end_health %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(t_hp, ct_hp),
    names_to = "team",
    values_to = "health"

      t_hp = "T",
      ct_hp = "CT"

ggplot(round_end_health_long, aes(x = map, y = health, fill = team)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Round-End Health by Map and Team",
    x = "Map",
    y = "Total Team Health",
    fill = "Team"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## diffs

```{r}
round_end_diffs <- filtered_rounds_map %>%
  filter(tick <= end_tick) %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  slice_max(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    alive_diff = t_alive - ct_alive,
    hp_diff = t_hp - ct_hp
  ) %>%
  collect()

round_end_diffs %>%
  group_by(map) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_alive_diff = mean(alive_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_alive_diff = sd(alive_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_hp_diff = mean(hp_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_hp_diff = sd(hp_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    rounds = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Win Distributions

## using unique Rounds

```{r}

```

```{r}
win_distributions_map <- filtered_rounds_map %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  filter(tick <= end_tick) %>%
  slice_max(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(match_id, round_num, map, winner_side) %>%
  group_by(map, winner_side) %>%
  summarise(
    rounds_won = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(map) %>%
  mutate(
    win_percentage = 100 * rounds_won / sum(rounds_won)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  collect()

ggplot(win_distributions_map,
       aes(x = map, y = win_percentage, fill = winner_side)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", win_percentage)),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Round-Win Percentage by Map and Side",
    x = "Map",
    y = "Rounds Won (%)",
    fill = "Winning Side"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
win_distributions_win_con_map <- filtered_rounds_map %>%
  filter(tick <= end_tick) %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  slice_max(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(match_id, round_num, map, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(map, reason_name) %>%
  summarise(
    rounds_won = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(map) %>%
  mutate(
    win_percentage = rounds_won / sum(rounds_won) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  collect()

ggplot(
  win_distributions_win_con_map,
  aes(x = map, y = win_percentage, fill = reason_name)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = if_else(
        win_percentage >= 3,
        sprintf("%.1f%%", win_percentage),
        ""
      )
    ),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Round-Win Percentage by Map and Win Condition",
    x = "Map",
    y = "Rounds (%)",
    fill = "Win Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Bomb statistics

```{r}
unique_rounds_bomb <- filtered_rounds_map %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  filter(tick <= end_tick) %>%
  slice_max(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(match_id, round_num, map, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  collect()
##

bomb_plant_summary <- unique_rounds_bomb %>%
  mutate(
    bomb_status = case_when(
      bomb_planted == TRUE  ~ "Planted",
      bomb_planted == FALSE ~ "Not planted",
      TRUE                  ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(bomb_status, name = "rounds") %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = 100 * rounds / sum(rounds)
  )

bomb_plant_summary
```

```{r}
planted_bomb_outcomes <- round_states_enriched %>%
  filter(bomb_planted == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  slice_min(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(match_id, round_num, map, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(
      reason_name == "bomb_defused" ~ "Bomb defused",
      reason_name == "target_bombed" ~ "Bomb exploded",
      is.na(reason_name) ~ "Unknown outcome",
      TRUE ~ as.character(reason_name)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    rounds = n(),

    # Time from round start until bomb plant
    mean_seconds_until_plant =
      mean(seconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_seconds_until_plant =
      median(seconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_seconds_until_plant =
      sd(seconds, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Time elapsed after bomb plant
    mean_seconds_after_plant =
      mean(seconds_since_plant, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_seconds_after_plant =
      median(seconds_since_plant, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_seconds_after_plant =
      sd(seconds_since_plant, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  collect()

planted_bomb_outcomes
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

plant_timing <- round_states_enriched %>%
  filter(bomb_planted == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  slice_min(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(match_id, round_num, map, seconds, reason_name)

post_plant_timing <- round_states_enriched %>%
  filter(bomb_planted == TRUE, tick <= end_tick) %>%
  group_by(match_id, round_num, map) %>%
  slice_max(tick, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(match_id, round_num, map, seconds_since_plant)

planted_bomb_outcomes <- plant_timing %>%
  inner_join(
    post_plant_timing,
    by = c("match_id", "round_num", "map")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(
      reason_name == "bomb_defused" ~ "Bomb defused",
      reason_name == "target_bombed" ~ "Bomb exploded",
      is.na(reason_name) ~ "Unknown outcome",
      TRUE ~ as.character(reason_name)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(map, outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    rounds = n(),

    mean_seconds_until_plant = mean(seconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_seconds_until_plant = median(seconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_seconds_until_plant = sd(seconds, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_seconds_after_plant =
      mean(seconds_since_plant, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_seconds_after_plant =
      median(seconds_since_plant, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_seconds_after_plant =
      sd(seconds_since_plant, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  collect()

planted_bomb_outcomes
```

```{r}
# Median times until and after the plant, in long format for faceting.
plot_data <- planted_bomb_outcomes %>%
  select(
    map, outcome,
    until_plant = median_seconds_until_plant,
    after_plant = median_seconds_after_plant
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(until_plant, after_plant),
    names_to = "timing",
    values_to = "median_seconds"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    timing = recode(
      timing,
      until_plant = "Until plant",
      after_plant = "After plant"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = outcome, y = median_seconds, fill = outcome)
) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", median_seconds)),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_grid(timing ~ map, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bomb Plant Timing by Map and Round Outcome",
    x = "Round outcome",
    y = "Median time (seconds)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )
```
